## Why

<!-- The problem that prompted this work: what was broken or missing, and for whom. Take it from the request or issue, not from the diff. Link related issues, e.g. "Addresses #12". -->

## What changed

<!-- A short summary of the new behavior, not a list of files. -->

## Diagram

<!-- A short, high-level diagram (e.g. Mermaid) of the change. Leave this out when it adds nothing, or for UI changes that have screenshots. -->

## Evidence

<!--
Proof the change solves the problem: screenshots, recordings (GIFs preferred), command output, test results.
Add BEFORE and AFTER images when the change is visible.
Say plainly what was not verified.
-->

## Release note

<!-- Optional. One or two sentences for users if this needs a callout in the release, such as a deprecation, a breaking change or a migration step. Leave it out otherwise. -->
